parole.significato: An earthwork raised to prevent inundation of low land by the sea or flooding rivers.
parole.testo: A variant of dike, from Northern Middle English dik and dike (“ditch”), from Old Norse díki (“ditch”). Influenced by Middle Dutch dijc (“ditch; dam”) and Middle Low German dīk (“dam”). parole.significato: A native or inhabitant of Flanders in Belgium.
parole.testo: From Middle English flameng, from late Old Norse Flæmingi, from Old Norse Flǽmingr, Middle Dutch Vlaminc, Vleminc, from Old Frisian (unattested) (compare West Frisian Flaming), from Proto-Germanic *flaumaz (“flowing, current (water)”) and the patronymic suffix *-ingaz (“belonging to, descended from”

parole.significato: To snatch; take up hastily; filch
